description: Review one access request: load it (with the requester's entitlements and other requests) from the stores, run the deterministic checks in code (role lookup, segregation-of-duties conflicts, roles already held, duplicate open request, duration against the policy limit), delegate the policy judgment to the access-reviewer subagent, then save a new review row, stamp the request with its id and recommendation, and append a reviewed event. Returns the saved review. Recommends grant / limit / escalate / deny for a human system owner; never grants or provisions anything itself. Reports found: false when the request id is unknown. Runs from the `review <id>` chat command and from the UI's Review button through the direct-invoke lane.

request_id.description: The request to review, e.g. req_tom_github_developer.
